exposure: ERa gene polymorphism (PvuII and Xba I SNPs)
ERa gene expression in placental tissues
outcome: Homeostasis model assessment of insulin resistance (IR)
cohort: The study participants consisted of 175 pregnant women with GDM and 240 healthy pregnant women.
finding: The C allele of PvuII in the ERa gene and elevated ERa expression in placental tissues were significantly associated with GDM, with the PvuII CC + CT genotype also linked to increased insulin resistance and ERa expression in GDM patients.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken from pregnant women (including placental tissues) identified with or without GDM.
